parsed.summary: Orbit Optics's surround-view camera kit shipment SH-0256 to Wacky Wheels Huntsville slips from 2027-03-29 to 2027-04-01. 6 affected production orders were moved to the earliest free slots (4 rescheduled, 2 transferred); 26 dealers were each notified once for 54 customer orders; 10 Platinum/Gold customers received loaners within pool limits.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a real incident of type supplier_delay. Rule 7 and Rule 8 conditions were satisfied as IDs and dates resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live schedule baseline matched before the first write.
